notes.title: Craft your face from sweat, cardboard and stickers!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=j4B2HmnDlcE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]We are happy to announce our latest feature in Paper Play VR: Face Customization![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972573/576074f6a9c8da3e4b78b57550c3834574ba929d.gif[/img]

Cut with scissors, paint with brushes and apply all types of stickers or googly eyes to create the most unique design for your face!

This small Demo of the customization system is only the tip of the iceberg, as we will add a lot more options in the future, as well as a similar system, that can be used to customize your hands in the game!

Let's be creative together and post your Designs on our Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/QuhjXqjvjn

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The Demo already contains three Minigames with a lot of different Levels. Join the Paper Playground and give it a shot! We are looking forward to hear your feedback!

We are currently working hard to finalize the Multiplayer Features of the game until the end of July, so that you can invite your friends and go on paperly adventures together!

Don't forget to sign up on our Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/studiomoondowner/paper-play-vr
